title: DSA: Hash Tables
description: A Hash Table is a data structure that maps keys to values using a special function called a hash function. It provides highly efficient data retrieval, with an average time complexity of O(1) for search, insert, and delete operations. It is the underlying technology for Python dictionaries.

challenges.title: Hash Complexity
challenges.exercise: Print 'O(1)' to confirm you know the average search complexity of a Hash Table.
